messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — we have a proposed opt-in SDK change that standardizes auth header names. Partners could be impacted. Posting the diff and rollout props.

maria: Proposed change:
```
- Headers: { 'X-Redwood-API': 'token' }
+ Headers: { 'Authorization-Redwood': 'token' }
```

maria: Plan: release as v2.1.0-beta, backwards-compatible for 30 days with a server-side fallback. After 30 days we'll emit deprecation warnings in logs and then 90-day sunset.

liam: What's the exact failure mode for older client libs? 401s?

aj: Older SDKs will still send X-Redwood-API. Server will accept both during the opt-in window; tokens accepted. After sunset, server will only accept Authorization-Redwood and return 401 + error_code `auth_header_deprecated`.

sophia: We have 3 partners on contract who pin SDKs. Need clear notice + migration guide. ETA for docs?

maria: Drafting a migration guide now — aim to send to partners next Tue (2026-07-07). Will include code snippets, a test checklist, and a rolling upgrade plan.

liam: Suggest we follow semver: bump minor and mark the change as breaking in the changelog; also add a deprecation header so clients can detect warnings.

aj: Server can emit header: `Warning: 299 - "X-Redwood-API deprecated; use Authorization-Redwood"` and also an `X-Redwood-Warn: auth-header` short header.

sophia: Can marketplace-listed partners opt into the new header earlier via a feature flag? Some want early access.

maria: Good ask — PM approved a feature-flag for marketplace partners. I'll coordinate with @carl to enable it for the pilot group.

release-bot: commit 7a3c4f2 — add auth header shim and deprecation warning (https://git.redwood/infra/commit/7a3c4f2)

aj: I'll add unit + integration tests (both headers, fallback, and warning header) in the release pipeline to prevent regressions.

sophia: I'll schedule partner outreach and include a short migration checklist and sample patches for node/python/ruby. cc: @legal for contract notification wording.

maria: Thanks team. If no major issues, we'll cut the beta on Friday and send partner communications next Tue. Quick sync Thurs 10am PT if needed. :thumbsup:
